answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable bond before receiving tasks, then release it only after independent reviewers confirm useful, nonduplicated work; copied or fraudulent output burns the bond. A Sybil attacker must fund every fake identity and keep that capital tied up while earning trust, making mass identities expensive rather than free. Random task assignment and cross-checks limit reuse. A river of aliases cannot bypass the toll; a vine spreads slowly, and ivory carries no special privilege.
